purpose: UD route-plan item B (impact-list task 2): the Q3_K-over-W4A16 mean-gate investigation - production-config gate numbers on this host, the operand-precision analysis, and the quantified upside.

findings.upside: prefill 477.1 -> 545.1 tok/s (+14.3%) with Q3_K routed, production config

gate_probe_production_config.method: incumbent = shipped 4-quant policy; candidate = same + gguf_q3_k; teacher-forced on the incumbent trajectory; 512-token contexts, 65 positions; null control (same policy both arms) is exactly 0
gate_probe_production_config.verdict: BLOCKED: 2/3 contexts over the 1e-3 mean, one breach of the 5e-2 absolute ceiling (5.82e-2 at seed 7). Consistent with and worse than the zbook recorded 6.1% mean overage; the route stays unrouted.

fp16_weight_rounding_mean_rel.note: Q3_K rounds to fp16 BETTER than every routed quant - the operand-precision hypothesis for Q3_K specifically is ruled out at the weight level

per_element_route_error_512_rows.note: both at the bf16-output floor; Q3_K is only 1.5x IQ4_XS per element - the mean delta is share (bytes) x noise volume, not a defect

operand_precision_analysis.conclusion: The zbook int8-vs-fp16 equality (routes differing in which operand is rounded, same mean) plus Q3_K rounding best-of-class points at accumulation structure, but no error-reduction lever is identified that provably clears the envelope; the hi/lo fp16 split addresses operand rounding only. The unblock is the recorded human decision: envelope re-calibration for UD scope (the 1e-3 was frozen on a 2026-08-16 Qwen3.5 calibration; hipEngine strict itself sits at 0.001271 vs the llama.cpp teacher) or a task gate.

findings.methodology_note: The first probe round ran with use_wmma_prefill=None (not production config); all numbers above are production config. The local32 decode probe was likewise re-run in production config after fixing a candidate-policy capture bug (the shipped empty policy made the candidate arm a no-op): means 8.0e-4/9.0e-4/1.6e-4 now pass but seed 23 fails top-1 (98.44%) - mixed failure modes, unrouted stays correct.

changes.scripts/gguf_iq_q3k_w4a16_gate.py: new teacher-forced probe for the Q3_K route
changes.scripts/gguf_iq_local32_decode_gate.py: production config + explicit candidate policy fix

limitations: Random-token 512-contexts, not the campaign 18-prompt category fixture (not present in this tree).
Three seeds; the zbook 162-row gate remains the definitive measurement.
